findings.reason: Incorrect behavior in the goal-named safe pane poke: a soft-wrapped CJK or emoji draft is classed safe and the retype corrupts the person's draft.
Incorrect extraction in the goal-named summary path: a fenced block becomes one multi-KB Error identifier stored and carried into every fold and bundle.
Query-plan cost of the poke lookup; output is correct, so it is a quality improvement to goal-named code rather than a correctness defect.
The new summary wire commands ship without a PROTOCOL_VERSION bump, so skew with an old daemon goes undetected and requests are dropped silently in a goal-named path.
The authoritative agent doc still says the plugin does not start a summary, which is misleading in the goal-named summary and recovery path.
Incorrect behavior in the summary path: a human seat's info or warn event line counts as a priority message and can be cited to supersede a user instruction.
Spill saves less than intended for decision and open-item entries; bundle_bytes is a soft target and the oversized flag still reports the real size, so correctness is unchanged.
findings.clusterOverride: Size-efficiency of a soft target only, with no wrong result, unlike the identifier cap which stores wrong data.

findings.reason: over_budget and sizes.fold_bytes understate the fold the caller receives, a misleading result in the goal-named summary path.
Truncating to 16 seats before the eligibility filters can leave later due seats never poked, so the goal-named poke does not fire for them.
Extra idle-tick transactions and a prepare inside a loop; a performance hardening that does not affect correctness.
Diagnostic label is lost for poke skips; the outcome itself is correct, so this is a diagnostics improvement.
Recovery read errors are swallowed with no diagnostic; behavior is otherwise correct, so this is a hardening and diagnostics improvement.
A personal-config leak in committed evidence files, which is not behavior the goal names.
Missing test coverage for the author_role backfill bound, which feeds the goal-named human-priority summary behavior.
Test flakiness under slow setup that was not reproduced; a test-robustness improvement, not a failing test.
Wall-clock sensitivity in a test that fails loudly when slow; a test-robustness improvement.
Optional marker and deferred-suffix tokens are missing from the documented row grammar, a doc-completeness gap rather than wrong behavior.
findings.clusterOverride: Grammar completeness only; it is fixed in the same docs sweep as the in-scope stale-summary text.

findings.reason: Operations doc lacks the effective-deadline, catch-up and poke description; documentation completeness, not a behavior defect.
findings.clusterOverride: Operator-doc completeness for the poke and deadline sections; the in-scope part of the cluster is the stale agent-usage summary text.

findings.reason: One-way migrations with no backup are a pre-existing pattern the goal does not name.
